interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at potential crossing points to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add high-visibility marked crosswalks with appropriate signage to provide designated safe crossing points.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming Measures
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to reduce vehicle speeds on this residential street.

interventions.title: Install Raised Curbs
interventions.description: Provide a standard 6-inch vertical curb to clearly demarcate and protect the pedestrian walkway from the roadway.

interventions.title: Street Lighting and Greenery
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale lighting and street trees to improve visibility, safety, and the overall walking environment.

interventions.title: Pavement Repair
interventions.description: Resurface the walkway to eliminate trip hazards and provide a smooth, accessible path.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the intersection to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade standard parallel line crosswalks to continental or ladder markings for better visibility.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or street furniture to create a physical and psychological buffer from traffic.

interventions.title: Street trees and landscaping
interventions.description: Add street trees or planters to create a protective buffer and improve the walking environment.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Midblock Crosswalk
interventions.description: Implement a marked midblock crossing with high-visibility 'continental' markings and appropriate signage.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strips
interventions.description: Add street trees between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a physical buffer for pedestrians and create a vertical sense of enclosure that naturally slows traffic.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near potential crossing points to ensure clear sightlines.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: A median refuge island would allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time, significantly improving safety on this wide road.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Adding a marked crosswalk with appropriate signage would provide a designated and safer crossing point for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to provide a safe crossing point for residents.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.

interventions.title: Street trees or planters
interventions.description: Add vegetation to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the number of through lanes to two and repurpose the space for protected bike lanes or wider sidewalk buffers.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Pave the missing section of the sidewalk to provide a continuous, accessible, and stable walking surface.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Implement vertical traffic calming to reduce vehicle speeds in this residential area.

interventions.title: Curb extensions and refuge islands
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at intersections and a mid-block refuge island to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Driveway consolidation
interventions.description: Reduce the number and width of driveway openings to the gas station to minimize conflict points.

interventions.title: Street trees and buffers
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or street trees between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a physical and psychological buffer from traffic.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add high-visibility crosswalk markings to designate safe crossing areas.

interventions.title: Continuous Sidewalk Treatment
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk across the gas station frontage using a consistent material and elevation to clearly define pedestrian priority.

interventions.title: Driveway Narrowing and Consolidation
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the curb cuts to the minimum necessary for vehicle access, using curbs and landscaping to separate the walkway from the gas station lot.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Install a furniture zone or planting strip between the roadway and the walkway to provide physical and psychological separation from moving traffic.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Repair and level the sidewalk surface to ensure a smooth, ADA-compliant path of travel.

interventions.description: Implement a planting strip between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a physical and psychological barrier from traffic.
